firm_data.firm_description: Kaufman Dolowich LLP is a leading national law firm representing clients across a wide range of industries in key practice areas. Headquartered on Long Island, N.Y., the firm advises national and global clients of all sizes.
notable_facts: Kaufman Dolowich is a seven-time Mansfield Certified law firm, recognized for its commitment to inclusive employment practices.

additional_contacts.name: Katherine S. Catlos
additional_contacts.title: Partner, Chief Diversity & Inclusion Officer, CIPP, US, CIPM

email.subject: AI for Kaufman Dolowich, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kristin,

As COO of a seven-time Mansfield Certified firm, you know the operational demands of scaling inclusive practices across 296 attorneys while maintaining precision in complex areas like Labor and Employment and Professional Liability.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-size practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping you compete without sacrificing quality.

Worth 20 minutes to explore?

Vasu
Lucio
